messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "may start to feel relief on first day"
set: ["may start to feel relief on first day", "doctor may start on cholesterol-lowering diet before giving drug", "first dose given on awakening", "doctor may start on low dose and raise it gradually", "start nicotine replacement product on the same day you quit smoking", "start with 25 mg a day", "first dose administered 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "older adults may be more likely to become dizzy or feel faint", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "first dose of the day is usually taken when first wake up", "start levothyroxine", "doctor will start on suitable dose and adjust gradually based on blood tests", "do not stop taking on your own without speaking to doctor first", "doctors usually start older adults on a low dose", "first dose given 30 minutes before the start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "first parenteral dose given 30 minutes before start of emetogenic chemotherapy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
